rows.product: Japanese-style high-carbon steel kitchen knife set (3 to 8 pieces) in a gift box or with a block

rows.sell_price_source: Proposed price. rows.cn_landed_label: ESTIMATED (AliExpress search card read 2026-11-21, ships from China; 'New shoppers save' promo price, repeat price UNKNOWN); 4-piece set with 'Free shipping' tag

The US listings found are generic block sets, not the premium-looking sets DTC brands sell at $169 and up, so the photos must match what ships. Injury complaints. Knife ads may be limited. The Amazon count covers every non-legacy knife set returned for 'japanese chef knife set' and 'damascus knife set', including generic block sets; listings with 'Damascus' in the title total only 4,450 units over 22 listings.

rows.category: winter and cold weather / battery heated wearables
rows.product: Rechargeable heated gloves (7.4V, two battery packs and charger in the box, 3 heat levels, touchscreen fingertips)
rows.what_it_solves: Hands that go numb while driving a cold car, scraping ice, shoveling, working outside, riding or watching a game. Ordinary gloves only slow heat loss; these add heat for several hours.
rows.sell_price_source: https://saviorheat.com/products/unisex-electric-heated-gloves-motorcycle-waterproof - VERIFIED 2026-11-21 (Savior Heat S66B Classic Heated Winter Gloves, $97.99 against a $139.99 compare-at price; product page and storefront search JSON agree). Other DTC prices read today: Ororo Calgary and Buffalo gloves from $99.99, Fieldsheer Squall 2.0 $99.99, Weston Heated Gloves $119.95, Venustas G02 $129.99, iHood $149.99, Gobi Heat $179 to $219; Kemimoto motorcycle gloves from $62.99. Amazon no-name listings sell at $47.48 to $84.99 (median $69.99), so a new store should also be run in the scripts at $79.99.
rows.us_landed_label: Lowest US-filter card price for a 7.4V glove with battery capacity in the title, free shipping, no new-shopper tag (listing 3256813438436126, 3 sold). Thin: the three cheapest clean listings show 2 to 4 sales each; the clean listing with real sales reads $48.69 (110 sold). VERIFIED as displayed on the AliExpress search card with the ship-from United States filter on, read 2026-11-21 in a headless browser. Item pages are captcha-blocked, so size or variant, what is in the box, stock depth and the regular price after the Black Friday promotion are NOT confirmed.
rows.cn_landed_label: VERIFIED as displayed (card with shipFromCountry=CN in the search URL, free shipping, 103 sold, no new-shopper tag). Ship-from was not confirmed on the page and delivery days were not shown. It is dearer than the US-stock cards, so China shipping has no price advantage here. Most-sold China-side cards ($16.77 and $7.30, 1K+ and 449 sold) carry new-shopper tags.
rows.bundle_idea: Gloves plus a two-pack of rechargeable hand warmers (US cards $9.33 to $15.95, from a different seller, so a second parcel) or a spare battery pair. A 'two pairs' offer for couples is the simpler way to lift order value from one supplier. Heated socks from the same store are the natural second product.
rows.whale_note: No single owner. Ororo is the category whale but its weight is in vests ('ororo heated vest' gets about as many searches as 'heated vest'); in gloves the Amazon $40-plus tier is spread over 69 listings with unbranded titles holding most of it, and the visible Meta advertisers are small (Invisible Heat, Weston, Savior Heat).
rows.ip_safety_flags: Lithium battery packs: UL, ETL or UN38.3 paperwork for the unit is UNKNOWN and must be asked for; heating element burn risk if a pack or wire fails. No health claims: competitors lean on Raynaud's, arthritis and circulation wording, which is out of scope here. Do not use Savior Heat, Ororo, Snow Deer or '3M Thinsulate' names unless the unit truly carries them. No patented design seen, generic construction.
rows.season_note: Best window of the year. 'heated gloves' about 165,000 US Google searches in Dec 2025, 90,500 in Jan 2026, 49,500 in Oct 2026, 3,600 in Jul 2026; CPC about $1.38 (ESTIMATED, DataForSEO, read 2026-11-21). Demand falls away by March, so this is a 10 to 12 week product.
rows.risks: 1) Sizing (S to XL) and fit returns. 2) Cheapest US listings have 2 to 4 sales, so quality and stock are unproven; the fast-lane sample should be ordered the day ads start (approved exception, flagged). 3) Battery or heating failures drive refunds and chargebacks; the US-stock sellers give no written defect terms we could read. 4) Amazon sells look-alikes at $47 to $85 with Prime delivery, and 42,450+ units a month sell under $40. 5) Card prices are Black Friday promotion prices. 6) Weight not shown on any listing read (UNKNOWN); a comparable heated sock kit lists 0.5 kg. 7) Meta CPMs peak in the launch week.
rows.rule_note: Lithium packs and a heating element worn on the body; battery paperwork (UL, ETL or UN38.3) UNKNOWN; sizing returns; season ends by March.

rows.sell_price_source: Proposed price for a complete pair. Amazon sets of 2 sell at $45 to $57 (VERIFIED via DataForSEO)
rows.us_landed_label: VERIFIED (AliExpress US search card read 2026-11-21 with the 'Shipping from: United States' filter; item page blocked by captcha, so shipping fee and delivery come from the card tags; a marketplace listing price, not a supplier quote). 12 sold. Styles closer to the Amazon best sellers cost $45.91 to $52.89 on the same filter.
rows.cn_landed_label: UNKNOWN: China cards show about $19 to $22 per light with no shipping fee and unclear pack size
rows.bundle_idea: Pair with bulbs and remote at $109.99; four-light room set as the step-up; matching rechargeable picture light as the add-on (Amazon 3-packs sell at $49 to $57).
rows.whale_note: No whale. 22 brands share 20,950 monthly Amazon units at $40 or more and no listing is above 2,000. Poplight is small and patent-protected; Pridola is a general home store pushing this item hard.

Rechargeable bulbs contain lithium cells. Adhesive mounting can fail on textured walls: include screws and say so. Avoid glass shades (fragile exclusion); choose fabric or metal. Weight 4.0 lb is the Amazon listing weight of the top set of 2 (1,830 g, VERIFIED via DataForSEO).
rows.season_note: Good. Searches rise in January ('battery operated wall sconces' 22,200 in Jan 2026 against 14,800 in Dec 2025 and Jul 2026); a home-refresh item, not tied to Christmas.
rows.risks: Amazon sells the same set of 2 at $45 to $57 with Prime, so the DTC premium rests on styling and photos. US listings have 0 to 12 sales. Battery life complaints (bulbs last hours, not weeks) are the typical review theme. Cost from US stock is high relative to the price unless the pair sells near $110.

rows.what_it_solves: The low-tire warning light that comes on with the first cold snap; topping up at home in two minutes instead of hunting for a gas-station air machine in the cold.
rows.sell_price_source: https://fanttik.com/products/x8-apex-tire-inflator - VERIFIED 2026-11-21 (Fanttik X8 APEX, $59.99 against a $99.99 compare-at price; X9 APEX $65.99, X10 Pro Max $89.99). Airmoto sells at $59.49 on Amazon (ESTIMATED, DataForSEO); airmoto.com showed no price today. This is at the bottom edge of the $60 to $150 band.
rows.us_landed_label: Lowest US-filter card price with sales for a cordless 150 PSI digital inflator, free shipping, no new-shopper tag (listing 3256813094620129, 16 sold). Battery size is not in the title; the larger-battery unit comparable to Airmoto's and Fanttik's reads $49.09. A card at $8.25 with no sales was ignored. VERIFIED as displayed on the AliExpress search card with the ship-from United States filter on, read 2026-11-21 in a headless browser. Item pages are captcha-blocked, so size or variant, what is in the box, stock depth and the regular price after the Black Friday promotion are NOT confirmed.
rows.cn_landed_label: UNKNOWN. China-side cards read $10.68 to $13.41 with 772 to 1K+ sold, all with new-shopper tags; ship-from and delivery days not shown.
rows.bundle_idea: Two-pack ('one for each car') or inflator plus a hard case, valve adapters and a digital gauge, to lift the order above $60. A single unit at the Airmoto price is the weakest version of this offer.
rows.whale_note: Two whales with large budgets. Airmoto is a DTC single-product brand built on paid ads (1.5 million units claimed, 10,000+ a month on Amazon at $59.49); Fanttik leads on Amazon and TikTok Shop. Every one of the top 12 Amazon listings at $40 or more is a named brand. A no-name inflator competes on the same promise at the same price.
rows.ip_safety_flags: Lithium battery with a motor and compressor: certification UNKNOWN; overheating on long fills is the usual complaint class. Pressure accuracy claims must match the unit. Do not use the Airmoto or Fanttik names, their product shapes or their images. No patent check was done on the handheld form; Airmoto's page should be checked for patent markings before any look-alike is sold.
rows.season_note: Good in winter. 'portable tire inflator' about 90,500 US Google searches in Dec 2025, 74,000 in Nov 2025, 49,500 in Jan 2026, 27,100 in Jul 2026; 'portable air compressor' 165,000 in Dec 2025; 'airmoto' 74,000 in Dec 2025 (ESTIMATED, DataForSEO, read 2026-11-21). A common gift for drivers.
rows.risks: 1) Brand-heavy market with two whales; the same repo scan on Nov 15 already flagged it as a lithium gadget. 2) 179,700+ units a month sell under $40 on Amazon, so a $59.99 price needs a reason. 3) The cheap US listings do not state battery size; a weak unit that cannot fill a car tire becomes a refund. 4) US listings have 3 to 16 sales. 5) Weight is ESTIMATED from the Airmoto Amazon listing. 6) Earlier repo research (data/opportunities.csv) priced this type at $30 to $40 and found it negative there; only a bundle changes that.
rows.rule_note: Lithium battery with a motor; certification UNKNOWN; two giant brands.

rows.product: Filtered shower head (handheld or fixed) with a 3-filter starter pack
rows.what_it_solves: Hard, chlorinated shower water and weak pressure; a filter cartridge in the head that is swapped every 2 to 3 months.
rows.sell_price_source: Proposed kit price (head plus 3 cartridges). Anchors: Weddell Duo $68.40 and MyHalos $59.99 on Amazon (VERIFIED via DataForSEO 2026-11-21); Eskiin $149 to $169 at https://eskiin.com/products.json (VERIFIED 2026-11-21); Afina $103.20 and Jolie $169 on Amazon (VERIFIED via DataForSEO)
rows.us_landed_label: VERIFIED (AliExpress US search card read 2026-11-21 with the 'Shipping from: United States' filter; item page blocked by captcha, so shipping fee and delivery come from the card tags; a marketplace listing price, not a supplier quote). Only 1 sale on the listing; whether it includes spare cartridges is not confirmed.
rows.cn_landed_label: UNKNOWN: China cards show $9.59 to $10.45 unit price (10,000+ sold) but no shipping fee
rows.bundle_idea: Head plus 3 cartridges at $79; replacement cartridges on subscribe-and-save (Amazon shows 43,300 replacement cartridge units a month at $20 or more across 30 listings).
rows.whale_note: Jolie is a famous, heavily funded brand at $169 and Eskiin outspends everyone visible on Meta at $149 to $169. They set a high price anchor, which helps a $79 kit, but they own the hair-and-skin story that we are not allowed to tell.
rows.ip_safety_flags: No health, hair-loss or skin claims (Dhruv's exclusion). 'NSF certified', 'removes 99% of chlorine' and similar need a real test report for the exact filter; generic 15 to 35 'stage' filters rarely have one. Do not copy Jolie or Eskiin design or wording. Plumbing fit (1/2 inch NPT) drives some returns. Weight 1.12 lb is the Amazon listing weight of Weddell Duo (VERIFIED via DataForSEO).
rows.season_note: Neutral to good. Flat demand all year ('filtered shower head' 110,000 Google searches in Dec 2025 and Jan 2026, 74,000 in Jul 2026). Not a gift item, so no post-Christmas drop.
rows.risks: The benefit is invisible in a 3-second ad unless a claim is made that we cannot support. Google CPC is $4.92 (DataForSEO), a sign of crowded bidding. US listings have 0 to 11 sales. Filter quality is unverifiable without lab data, so refund risk if buyers expect Jolie-level results.

rows.product: Booster car seat bed for small and medium dogs (bolstered seat with tether); center-console seat as a smaller variant
rows.what_it_solves: A small dog slides around or climbs into the driver's lap; the raised, walled seat keeps the dog in one place, lets it see out and keeps hair and mud off the car seat.
rows.sell_price_source: https://funnyfuzzy.com/products/waterproof-dog-car-seat-bed-firstclass - VERIFIED 2026-11-21 via the store's public search JSON (Waterproof Dog Car Seat Bed - First Class, from $69.99, compare-at $93.99; the product page showed $71.99 for the default option). The store's most-reviewed seat, Dog Car Seat Bed - First Class, was $63.99.
rows.us_landed_label: Lowest US-filter card price without a new-shopper tag for a bolstered plush booster seat (listing 3256813414471243), free shipping included. This listing shows no sales count and 'only 1 left', so treat it as thin; the most-sold matching listing reads $35.13 (27 sold) and a Lealchum-style foam booster reads $50.49. VERIFIED as displayed on the AliExpress search card with the ship-from United States filter on, read 2026-11-21 in a headless browser. Item pages are captcha-blocked, so size or variant, stock depth and the regular (non-promotion) price are NOT confirmed; AliExpress was running a Black Friday promotion (cards show an end date of Dec 4).
rows.cn_landed_label: UNKNOWN. Unit prices of $14.44 (console style) and $27.61 read on AliExpress cards without the US filter; shipping cost and time not shown. The seat is bulky, so China parcel shipping is likely to be material.
rows.bundle_idea: Seat plus seat-belt tether, a washable spare liner and a collapsible travel bowl at about $79, which is also FunnyFuzzy's free-shipping threshold. The same buyer is the Barkfare customer, so the store, pixel data and creative carry over to the slow lane.
rows.whale_note: No giant owns this. On Amazon the $40-plus tier is spread over many sellers (Lealchum about 4,050 units, Joejoy 3,200, BurgeonNest 1,600 among 75 listings). FunnyFuzzy is the visible DTC leader and it ships slowly by its own policy, which is the opening for a 2 to 8 day US-stock offer.
rows.ip_safety_flags: Never claim crash protection, 'safety seat' or any tested standard; the tether clips to a harness, not a collar, and the page must say so. Not a child restraint: keep all child-seat language (ISOFIX, LATCH) out unless the unit truly has it; FunnyFuzzy sells ISOFIX versions and Petsfit advertises a 'Patented Safety Buckle', so avoid those specific designs. Do not copy FunnyFuzzy's 'First Class' name or photos.
rows.season_note: Acceptable in December, softer in January and February. 'dog car seat' about 40,500 US Google searches in Dec 2025, 33,100 in Jan and Feb 2026, 49,500 in Oct 2026; 'dog booster car seat' 2,900 a month (3,600 in Dec 2025); CPC about $1.06 to $1.43 (ESTIMATED, DataForSEO, read 2026-11-21). Holiday road trips and gifts help December; the yearly peak is summer travel.
rows.risks: 1) Only part of the demand is at the price we need: at $60 or more Amazon shows 24 listings and 3,900+ units, of which Lealchum is about 2,650; 84 listings sell 24,550+ units under $40. 2) US-stock listings are thin (0 to 27 sold), so stock can vanish mid-test. 3) Bulky, so a return costs real postage. 4) Fit complaints (dog weight, seat shape). 5) Any hint of a safety claim is a liability risk; product liability cover is needed before the first sale.

rows.what_it_solves: Dust, hair and debris inside mattresses, pillows and sofas that a normal vacuum misses; the clear bin shows what came out.
rows.sell_price_source: Jigoo sells its bed vacuums from $75.99 (S100) to $169.99 (T600), with J200 from $99.99 and J300 from $104.99 (VERIFIED read of https://jigoolife.com 2026-11-21). Sakerplus undercuts at $44.99 to $46.99 (VERIFIED, https://sakerplus.com/products.json)
rows.us_landed_label: ESTIMATED (AliExpress US search card read 2026-11-21, US ship-from filter; the card carries a 'New shoppers save' tag, so this is a first-order promo price and the repeat price is UNKNOWN). Free shipping and 6-day tags on the card. The same product is $51.77 to $60.90 on vevor.com and other US cards without promo pricing are $69.59 to $71.49, so plan on the higher figures.
rows.cn_landed_label: VERIFIED (AliExpress US-site search card read 2026-11-21, ships from China per the card trace; item page blocked by captcha); 'Free shipping' tag; a cordless, weaker 10 kPa model

rows.rule_note: UV light: no germ-killing or health claims allowed without proof.

rows.product: Portable 7 to 9 inch dash-mount screen that adds wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto to an older car (plugs into the 12V socket, sound through FM, AUX or Bluetooth)
